newsitem.title: NORWAY: Hydro awards contract for Oseberg South.
newsitem.headline: Hydro awards contract for Oseberg South.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA said on Friday it had awarded a 300 million crown contract to Norway's Bentec Norge AS for the construction of the drilling module for the Oseberg South platform.
Hydro is operator of licences 079, 104 and 171, which cover the Oseberg South prospect.
The contract covers the engineering, procurement and fabrication of the module, Hydro said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.
Total development costs for the field are estimated around 7.6 billion crowns.

Partners in Oseberg South are Norsk Hydro with 21.88 percent, Den norske stats oljeselskap AS with 56.58 percent, Saga Petroleum ASA with 10.14 percent, Conoco with 7.7 percent and Mobil Explration with 3.7 percent.
